discovery.definition: Enables runtime discovery of available FFT files, operators, substrates, and lattice configurations from the canon repository.
discovery_protocol: 1. Load fft.ai.index.json to enumerate all files and their canon_id + lattice node.
2. Load fft.ai.capabilities.json to determine substrate-available capabilities.
3. Load fft.ai.registry.json to resolve operator → file mappings.
4. Validate all discovered files against spec_version 1.2.0.
5. Report any spec_version mismatches as FFT-WARN-DISCOVERY-VERSION.
